$comment: The staff area's alerts (spec 02 §18.2; spec 08 §7.8 group C), from the steward's ruling of 22 Nov: access-keys-unavailable. L-SAT-09 adds the rest of the area's alerts (owed in catalog/owed.ts). Only admin's API half checks the Access token, so only admin writes access.keys_unavailable.

alerts.name: access-keys-unavailable
alerts.incident_cause: Fin Admin's API half could not read Cloudflare Access's signing keys and refused requests with 503: staff cannot use Fin Admin. Refusals: {{value}}.

metadata.check: Cloudflare's status for Access; the admin service's FIN_ACCESS_TEAM setting against the Zero Trust team name; the release.
